title: Identification of acrylamide-based covalent inhibitors of SARS-CoV-2 (SCoV-2) Nsp15 using high-throughput screening and machine learning
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,10243-10256
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06955B, Paper

Teena Bajaj, Babak Mosavati, Lydia H. Zhang, Mohammad S. Parsa, Huanchen Wang, Evan M. Kerek, Xueying Liang, Seyed Amir Tabatabaei Dakhili, Eddie Wehri, Silin Guo, Rushil N. Desai, Lauren M. Orr, Mohammad R. K. Mofrad, Julia Schaletzky, John R. Ussher, Xufang Deng, Robin Stanley, Basil P. Hubbard, Daniel K. Nomura, Niren Murthy
This study presented a novel screening of acrylamides discovering them as inhibitors against Nsp15 from SARS-CoV-2 and utilizing the data to develop an AI model to screen more inhibitors virtually.
